summary: Executed backend+frontend regression focused on live editor persistence/auth/session/site-text behavior using real preview APIs and compiled frontend build interception (document + /static only). Core dock persistence, logout sync, stale edit-flag blocking, site-live allowlist enforcement, and auth refresh/login security checks passed. One intermittent panel-open issue observed once after reload during compiled run; not consistently reproducible.

ui_bugs.component: Live editor panel toggle after save/reload (compiled run)
ui_bugs.issue: Observed one timeout where panel did not appear immediately after clicking dock toggle post-reload; subsequent retries and follow-up runs worked.

integration_issues.issue: Console still shows repeated 401 network errors for /api/auth/me while unauthenticated (expected auth probe behavior, noisy logs).

action_items: Investigate intermittent panel-open race after reload in compiled mode (toggle click sometimes does not mount panel on first attempt).

Run an additional deep pass for remaining unverified scope items: exhaustive per-field image/nested path edits, undo/redo across multiple mutations, all responsive breakpoints (320/390/768/1440/1920) with layout regression capture, and full Field Note mutation matrix (references/download labels/styles).
Optionally reduce unauthenticated /api/auth/me 401 noise in console/logs if product wants cleaner public-browser telemetry.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth playbook checks passed in code+runtime: bcrypt hash format ($2b$), httpOnly access/refresh cookies, explicit credentialed CORS origin, brute-force lockout after 5 failures, and seed behavior updates existing admin hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Live editor permission gate is role-based via can('content.publish') with read-only suppression in preview/editor-preview; anonymous users cannot force editor via sessionStorage or ?edit.
New /api/admin/site-live path validation is correctly allowlisted (public copy paths only) and rejects arbitrary or missing menu paths.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed tests passed (25 passed, 2 skipped in full suite run)
success_rate.frontend: ~88% targeted compiled-flow checks passed (core flows green, one intermittent panel-open timeout)

seed_data_creation: No new users/accounts created. Temporary content mutations (home heading/tagline) were restored to original values within the same run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compiled-build validation was executed using Playwright route interception for document+/static assets only; /api calls remained real. Verified: login without ?edit, dock persistence across nine public routes, close state retaining launcher, direct-route reload persistence, unsaved-change prompt cancel behavior, page title control visible on pages and absent on note editor, note editor lacks add-section controls, logout removes dock in current+second tab (storage sync), stale sessionStorage usp-live-edit + ?edit does not re-enable editor for anonymous state, and editor-preview mode hides dock/panel. Could not finish full exhaustive image/nested-path matrix in this pass.
rca of the issue: Intermittent UI timing/race condition suspected around dock-toggle->panel mount after reload in compiled mode. Repro happened once right after a save+reload sequence, then did not recur in follow-up retries. Potential cause areas: state transition between active/scope/sessionStorage sync and rehydration timing after route reload. Mitigation: add deterministic post-reload stabilization (e.g., await auth/site hydration complete before allowing toggle action) or debounce toggle until provider ready.
